TURN_LINE.meaning: Local/internal turn line used for structure interpretation.
TURN_LINE.note: Current research rule: TURN_LINE is not automatically drawn. A future change requires new evidence and a new version.

active_large_dow_high_gate.meaning: The currently relevant large-Dow structural/swing high that must be exceeded before large-Dow rising is promoted.

when_small_break_but_large_gate_unbroken.interpretation: Local rise can exist while the higher-order structure remains capped by the large-Dow high.

structural_high_confirmation.candidate_meaning: A meaningful rising-wave apex/high before full structural confirmation.

RETRACE_38_CONFIRMED.meaning: The active rise has retraced at least 38%.

PROTECTED_LOW_BROKEN.meaning: The last pullback low protecting the rise has been broken by a later closed-bar close.

supersedes_prior_b02_03_simplifications.prior: Structural-high/red-circle breakout promotes the red/cyan local TL to an important line.
supersedes_prior_b02_03_simplifications.replacement: The local turn line remains TURN_LINE and VALID_SUPPRESSED; the breakout changes Dow hierarchy state, not the line role.

supersedes_prior_b02_03_simplifications.prior: A second post-break low universally promotes/confirms the large-Dow TL as a current line.
supersedes_prior_b02_03_simplifications.replacement: Large-Dow TL identity/importance is a separate structural role. Do not use the second-low event as a universal line-promotion shortcut.

supersedes_prior_b02_03_simplifications.prior: High/gate and protected-low break semantics were unfixed between wick and close.
supersedes_prior_b02_03_simplifications.replacement: Both are confirmed only by CLOSED_BAR_CLOSE; wick-only penetration does not count.

unfixed_items: Objective deterministic classifier that maps pivots into SMALL_DOW/MID_DOW/LARGE_DOW labels in every case.
guardrails: Keep RETRACE_38_CONFIRMED and PROTECTED_LOW_BROKEN as separate booleans.
Do not weaken or alter the Production 38% turn detector in NVT7.1.
Confirm high/gate breaks only by closed-bar close; wick-only penetration does not count.
Confirm LAST_PULLBACK_LOW/PROTECTED_LOW breaks only by closed-bar close; wick-only penetration does not count.
Do not promote TURN_LINE merely because a local structural high is broken.
Do not automatically display TURN_LINE under the current research contract.
Do not equate local SMALL_DOW_RISING with LARGE_DOW_PROMOTED.
Do not modify frozen NVT7 or Production Normal Run from this adjudication.
